about_short_description.short_description: LitHit creates smart shooting targets that light up on impact.

product.name: Smart Targets
product.description: Targets that light up upon being hit, designed for use with any live-fire ammunition from any firearm.

product.name: Live-Fire Gamification
product.description: A system that combines the excitement of video games with live-fire shooting, offering competitive games and training.

product.name: Trainer
product.description: A tool that assists with shooting mechanics and efficiency, providing coaching on response time and cadence.

product.name: Spotter
product.description: A feature that provides real-time feedback by calling out hits and lighting up targets.

product.name: Shot Logger
product.description: A system that automatically logs hits, split times, and training scores.
